rights.metadata: Object-scoped visibility only; prove GUID/extended-property queries as restricted principal before acceptance; no server-wide metadata grant by assumption

systemProcedure: sys.sp_getapplock with public DB principal and Transaction owner; verify inherited ability, no broad EXECUTE grant
credentialHandling: New dedicated credential retained only in protected local secret channel; connection/password process environment, no Git/command arguments/logs; login creation/grants separately approved by Security/SQL Owner; record effective SID and rights after provision
isolation: SQL rights are table/column scoped, not row scoped. Entire DB and its fixtures must be disposable/exclusive; admin provisioner is a separate identity.
